quests.conceptTitle: Modifier Placement: Degree Adverb Placement (Before Adjective/Adverb)
quests.targetSentence: The lecture was very informative.
quests.awkwardSentence: Very the lecture was informative.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Very' intensifies the adjective 'informative', so it sits directly before it: 'very informative'.
quests.nativeTip: This word strengthens the adjective right after it - keep them together.
quests.visualAnchor: 🎯 Place 'very' right next to the word it describes: 'The lecture was very informative.'
quests.comedyNote: Misplacing 'very' produces awkward phrasing like: 'Very the lecture was informative.'. Always anchor modifiers adjacent to the words they modify.
